question: Does transparent source-content case retrieval select paired explicit operators that transfer better than fixed global, source-ridge, top-1 and K=1 medoid controls?

primary_method_basis.paper: InstantRetouch: Personalized Image Retouching without Test-time Fine-tuning Using an Asymmetric Auto-Encoder
primary_method_basis.used_idea_only: fixed top-3 application-source to historical-before retrieval with temperature 0.1 over a frozen representation; no paper code, weights, architecture, dataset or thresholds beyond K and temperature are used
primary_method_basis.clean_room_difference: retrieval blends only bounded explicit operator parameters fitted from same-content pairs and never generates final RGB

retrieval.feature: REPID13 global-plus-4x4 spatial descriptor applied to application sources and historical case before-images
retrieval.standardization: fit-only per-coordinate mean and standard deviation with 1e-8 floor
retrieval.similarity: cosine on standardized features with zero-norm rejection
retrieval.hard_medoid_control: K=1 observed paired-latent Euclidean medoid over all fit cases
retrieval.source_ridge_control: fit-only ridge from historical before-image descriptor to bounded operator parameters
retrieval.paired_latent_top3_oracle: diagnostic only after prediction freeze; Euclidean distance in the frozen REPID13 paired-latent PCA space with the same top-3 and temperature

stop_rules: Reuse the exact REPID13 roles, descriptor, paired-latent PCA and bounded operator without changing their values.
All calibration retrieval neighbors, weights and candidate/control parameters freeze after reading application sources but before any calibration target is read.
The paired-latent top-3 oracle is computed only after prediction freeze and is diagnostic, never an input to the candidate.
Any calibration gate failure closes before sealed original or render acquisition.
No K, temperature, feature metric, medoid count, ridge, bounds, dose, role, threshold or gate rescue is allowed on this cohort.
A pass opens only a separately frozen sealed confirmation and does not prove latent modes or promote product behavior.
claim_ceiling: Private internal-research source-content case routing over paired-supervised bounded explicit operators; not latent-mode, population preference, film, stock, scanner, arbitrary-source, package, capability or product evidence.
